reconciledFindings.http401RootCause: The Codex App Server in an isolated CODEX_HOME has no user auth token (account/read returns no account). The App Server emits turn/started upon local task admission before dispatching to OpenAI; the backend request then fails with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
reconciledFindings.tokenSharingPolicy: OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT (SIWC) and Token Sharing for Open Source imposes preview limitations: third-party orchestrators cannot extract or reuse user tokens without registered OAuth client credentials and user consent.
reconciledFindings.sessionLocking: Codex enforces thread-writer file locks in the same CODEX_HOME, but has no owner-generation fencing (POC-05 S2: stale owner writes are accepted). Deszo trusted host must enforce single-writer admission and fencing.
reconciledFindings.nativeQueueStatus: thread/queue/add is locked behind experimentalApi capability. In default mode, turn B accepted during active turn A is dropped/not started if turn A fails (POC-04 FAIL). Deszo must maintain serialized queueing on the host.

statusReason: Codex App Server requires authorized user credentials in the working profile. In isolated profiles, model execution fails with 401. Third-party subscription use is subject to SIWC preview limitations.
